name: Janus kinase family (JAK1/JAK2/JAK3, user-supplied pooled dataset)
limitations: Source file has no per-row JAK1/JAK2/JAK3 target label, assay type, relation, unit, or provenance.
The endpoint is retained as user-supplied pChEMBL value; it must not be represented as an independently validated IC50 model.
All 10,070 unique structures overlap the existing local JAK2 training dataset, so this dataset cannot be used as an independent test.
